description: Set type preferences: Type Contextual Controls (alternates and fraction badges on selected text), font locking for Roman and Asian characters, and the HarfBuzz shaping engine for Indic and Latin text. Returns the current values; with no arguments it only reports them

fontChangeLocking.description: Font locking: keep Roman fonts off Asian characters (and the reverse) when changing fonts

harfbuzzShaping.description: Shape Indic and Latin text with the HarfBuzz engine (default shaping engine)

scope.description: Where harfbuzzShaping is set: the application default or the active document

showAlternates.description: Show the contextual badge for OpenType alternates on selected text (Type > Type Contextual Controls > Show Adornment)

showFractions.description: Show the contextual badge for fractions

name: set_type_preferences
title: Set Type Preferences
